scope: Pre-answer read-out only: one final prompt state per held-out question, correlated with that question's subsequent sampled-answer accuracy.

correlation.outcome_y_i: For a question i, y_i is n_exact_correct / (n_exact_correct + n_incorrect) across its sampled generations. Excluded/empty generations are omitted from this denominator; questions with no retained answer have y_i=None and are omitted from correlation.
correlation.score_multiplicity: One h_i^pre and one projection score per question. The score is not recomputed per generation, so all generations of the same question share the same pre-answer score.
correlation.ci: 1,000 question-clustered bootstrap resamples; seed 42; percentile 95% interval.
correlation.random_test: For each of 1,000 L2-normalized Gaussian random directions (torch seed 123), compute signed Spearman rho. The one-sided p is (1 + count(rho_random >= rho_MD)) / 1001; it is not an absolute-value test.

pre_answer_position.context: Generation prompt before any answer token is supplied.
pre_answer_position.prompt_rendering: Chat template is rendered with add_generation_prompt=True.
pre_answer_position.pre_answer_token_position: The final input token position, len(input_ids)-1, after the assistant-generation marker and immediately before the first generated answer token.
pre_answer_position.triviaqa_prompt: Five fixed closed-book QA demonstrations plus Q: <question> A:. Qwen/Llama use system+user messages; Mistral uses one user message containing the demonstrations and question.
pre_answer_position.mistral_position: The final token of Mistral's single-user rendered chat prompt after add_generation_prompt=True; no answer token has been input.

direction.question_overlap_with_probe_training: None in reported evaluation: source MD direction is trained on the source train split, while D.4 uses held-out test questions.

arc_easy_random_direction_control: Not run for the canonical ARC-Easy pre-answer result.
